Latin word

vōx

vōx, vōcis f.

noun, third declension

the voice; its tone; voice; a sound, a word spoken; a word as spoken, a saying; voice

    the recommended word · classical · Gell. 1.26.8: ex vōce; Cic. de Or. 3.216 (Lewis & Short: “a voice, sound, tone”)
